title: Giant Portobello Mushrooms with Mushroom Duxelles
subtitle: served on rocket
description: Large portobello caps are filled with a classic mushroom, shallot and thyme duxelles with breadcrumbs, then baked and served on rocket.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Remove the stems from the portobello mushrooms, brush the caps with olive oil, season with salt and pepper and place on a baking tray lined with baking paper.
Finely chop the mixed mushrooms and shallot. Place the chopped mushrooms in a clean cloth and squeeze out the liquid.

Heat the butter and 1 tablespoon olive oil in a frying pan and saute the shallot for 2 minutes. Add the chopped mushrooms and cook over high heat for 1 to 2 minutes. Season with thyme, salt and pepper.
When the mushrooms are golden, add the wine and let it evaporate for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Stir in the breadcrumbs, parsley and Parmesan. Divide the filling between the mushroom caps.
Bake for 20 minutes until the mushrooms are nicely browned. Serve hot on a bed of rocket.
